evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `_load_helper(...)` is called at line 2490 before the `switch` argument validation at lines 2492-2494 (and the checkout-switch check at 2505-2507). An invalid combination such as `switch --unit crq-tick.service` without `--runtime` is therefore processed only after helper loading, so a helper load/hash error can mask the argument error and the normal path raises `Refused` instead of a usage error. The checks depend only on parsed arguments, so the smallest fix is to run them before `_load_helper` and route them through `parser.error`, consistent with the existing health argument check at 2472-2473.
